text:
publishbot: publish job failed for infra/worker:v1.27.4 -> digest sha256:abc123. Mirror (GCR) attestation check failed: manifest.annotation.timestamp (2024-03-01T12:34:00Z) > cosign.attestation.timestamp (2024-03-01T11:50:00Z). Skipping promote. logs: https://ci.internal/publish/1726405566
joan: we were in canary promote window, QA is mid-run. Do we rollback the canary or pin?
anya: quick scan: cosign signatures valid on primary ECR, but mirror process appears to rewrite manifest list and resets annotation timestamps to mirror push time. That causes ordering inversion and provenance guard rejects it. @ben can you confirm mirror behavior?
ben: yes, mirror agent does a manifest list rewrite for multi-arch bundles and re-emits annotations. It doesn't currently preserve original manifest.created_at when republishing. Fix will take a bit.
rob: immediate mitigation: pin canary back to last-known-good digest and pause release. Create a short release-hold note.
sre-oncall: agree. I'll set release flag to HOLD and open an incident so product/ops are alerted. :warning:
joan: rob, can you run rollback and update the release notes to reflect a delayed promote?
rob: doing rollback now. command:
```
deploybot rollback infra/worker --to-digest sha256:prev111 --reason "mirror attestation timestamp inversion"
```
deploybot: rollback executed, canary pods restarted with sha256:prev111. No restart errors.
anya: filed ENG-2381 to add a publishbot preflight that checks attestation timestamp ordering and fails earlier with clearer error.
ben: plan to patch mirror agent: 1) stop rewriting manifest timestamps, 2) preserve original created_at annotation when re-publishing, 3) run small replay to verify. ETA ~40m. I'll also coordinate with release owner once done.
publishbot: manual hold set by @sre-oncall.
joan: QA, please verify current canary health. If green, we'll leave canary pinned until mirror fix and re-publish flow completes.
sre-oncall: incident INC-4522 created, notifying #product and #customer-success. Tentative next promote in ~1h.
rob: added note to changelog: "Promotion paused due to mirror attestation timestamp mismatch; no user impact; retag + republish scheduled."
ben: mirror patch deployed and tested in staging, now re-pushing signed manifest from primary. Will post result.
publishbot: re-run publish job succeeded for infra/worker:v1.27.4 -> sha256:abc123 after mirror patch. verify logs: https://ci.internal/publish/1726407000
joan: thanks. Holding final promote until QA confirms green. Close thread when promote complete.
anya: follow-up ticket ENG-verify-2399 to add preflight and a short runbook for mirror incidents.
sre-oncall: holding message to #product updated; will reopen incident if any regression seen.
